text:
maria: Quick poll — editor speed-edit showdown! For tiny edits (fixing a typo, one-liner), which editor do you reach for first? React with 1/2/3/4 or just reply.
pollbot: Poll created: 1) VS Code 2) Neovim 3) Emacs 4) nano — voting open for 15m. (Use emoji 1️⃣ 2️⃣ 3️⃣ 4️⃣)
aj: 1️⃣ — VS Code. Quick Open + Command Palette = 2-second fix :rocket:
devon: 2️⃣ here. Neovim muscle memory for anything under 5 lines :sunglasses:
sam: I flip between 1️⃣ and 2️⃣. If I need to run something quick I pick VS Code, but Neovim for single-file edits.
kai: 3️⃣ for me. Emacs for long-form editing, but VS Code for debugging.
maria: Tally at 15m: VS Code 2, Neovim 1, Emacs 1, nano 0. Nice split. Also, spin-off poll — lunch decision: ramen :ramen: vs tacos :taco: — drop emoji to vote.
aj: :ramen: all the way.
devon: :taco: tacos please.
sam: :ramen: comfort food.
kai: :taco: spicy tacos pls.
maria: Current lunch tally: ramen 2, tacos 2 — looks tied. Anyone want to break tie or shall I coinflip? :coin:
aj: coinflip please :coin:
maria: flipping... heads = ramen, tails = tacos
pollbot: Coinflip result: tails — tacos! :tada:
maria: Tacos it is. I'll order from El Gallo at 12:15. Any dietary restrictions or toppings to note?
aj: none here, thanks!
devon: GF tortilla option would be great for me.
maria: Noted — GF for devon. Thanks everyone :chef: Enjoy the rest of your edits / lunch plans!
